acceptanceCriteria.text: CommentsTab no longer renders its own pending-image list or attach button; it uses ImageAttachField.
Paste or drop on the comment textarea still attaches, and Add comment is disabled during an upload.
After a send, the next upload shows and sends only the new image.
CommentsTab, CardFormDialog and TicketEditor.attachments tests pass.

body:
src/renderer/src/ticket/CommentsTab.tsx:83-105 (PendingImages) and :156-159 (attach button) duplicate src/renderer/src/attachments/ImageAttachField.tsx:49-65. Keep two behaviours: paste/drop on the textarea (targetProps at :150; test drops there, CommentsTab.test.tsx:63) and Add comment disabled while uploading (images.busy, :124,160). Trap: after a send, clearing the parent list leaves the field's internal pending list, which ImageAttachField.tsx:30-35 would bring back on the next upload.

## Do
1. ImageAttachField.tsx: add optional props children?: ReactNode (rendered first inside the target <div> at line 41, so paste/drop on a child is taken) and onBusyChange?(busy: boolean): void, with useEffect(() => { onBusyChange?.(attach.busy) }, [attach.busy]).
2. CommentsTab.tsx: delete PendingImages (83-105) and the attachmentUrl and useImageAttach imports (lines 4, 6); import ImageAttachField and FormImage. sendComment (107-115) takes images: FormImage[]. In CommentForm (117-166): state images: FormImage[], uploading: boolean, fieldKey: number; render <ImageAttachField key={fieldKey} runner folderKey images onChange={setImages} onBusyChange={setUploading}> with the existing <label className="tp-field"> and textarea (minus {...images.targetProps}) as its child; remove the attach <label> from tp-row-actions; use busy || uploading where busy || images.busy was; after a successful send setDraft(''), setImages([]), setFieldKey(k => k + 1), then onAdded().

## Out of scope
useImageAttach internals, CardFormDialog, TicketEditor, CSS.

## Tests
src/renderer/src/ticket/CommentsTab.test.tsx: existing tests at 45 and 76 stay green unchanged (the drop still targets the textarea). New 'disables Add comment while an image uploads' (uploadAttachment returns a promise resolved later: disabled after the drop, enabled after resolving). New 'does not bring back a sent image with the next upload' (upload A, send, upload B: only B's preview shows and the second addComment sends [B]). Also run CardFormDialog and TicketEditor.attachments tests.

## Rules
This card is the complete fix: nothing it finds is left for a later card. Fix anything that blocks a criterion inside this card. Run the listed tests, `npm run typecheck`, and `npx oxlint` on the touched files.
title: Reuse ImageAttachField in the comment composer
